evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We introduce TouchBench, an egocentric vision-language-tactile benchmark that distinguishes visually answerable questions (Tier A) from those involving properties hidden from the camera (Tier B).

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used for embodied perception and reasoning, yet their physical understanding is largely evaluated on questions answerable from images.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Four state-of-the-art VLMs average 66.4% accuracy on Tier A relative questions but only 49.8% on Tier B, near chance (50%).

evidence.label: 给出任务规模或覆盖范围
evidence.excerpt: It pairs head-mounted video with synchronized 137-channel whole-hand tactile sensing, comprising 900 clips from five participants across 11 tasks, with 900 absolute and 4,102 relative questions.
